translations.answer: In the G1 and cross-simulator settings of the ASAP report, small delta actions are learned as target physics trajectories and frozen in the training simulation to fine-tune the main policy. This approach reduces long-term dynamics and action tracking errors compared to SysID, delta dynamics, and uniform action noise. The residual model is only valid within its collected version/operating condition, and the issue has been reported alongside thermal damage to two robots.
translations.applicability.assumptions.0: Representative target-physics state/action trajectories can be collected and synchronized.
translations.applicability.assumptions.1: The residual model is revalidated for the robot, firmware, load and thermal state.
translations.confidence_rationale: Two cross-simulator benchmarks, real tracking comparisons, extensive ablations and public code support the mechanism. Confidence is capped by only two representative real quantitative motions and a 4-DoF rather than full-body real delta model.
translations.evidence.0.note: Defines the delta-action alignment and compares SysID, delta dynamics, noise and fine-tuning choices.
translations.evidence.0.title: ASAP: Aligning Simulation and Real-World Physics for Learning Agile Humanoid Whole-Body Skills
translations.evidence.1.locator: DeltaA_OpenLoop._compute_torques, DeltaA_ClosedLoop._compute_torques and PPODeltaA._rollout_step at df5320c
translations.evidence.1.note: Maps the residual and policy fine-tuning mechanism to official code.
translations.evidence.1.title: LeCAR-Lab/ASAP official implementation
translations.safety.command_limits: Derive robot/firmware-specific joint position, velocity, torque, current, temperature and task-energy envelopes; paper jump and gain settings are not deployment limits.
translations.safety.emergency_stop: Test an independent emergency stop and safe power-removal behavior before dynamic data collection.
translations.safety.protective_controls: Use fall arrest or padded capture where compatible, an exclusion zone, thermal/current monitoring, inspection intervals and a dedicated safety operator.
translations.safety.robot_specific_warning: The real delta model covers four G1 ankle DoFs under the reported setup; other joints, robots, firmware, payloads or wear states require recollection and review.
translations.safety.staged_deployment: Validate target-dynamics replay in simulation, then low-energy supported motions, locomotion, partial dynamic skills and only then bounded agile actions with abort thresholds.
translations.title: How to Improve Simulation-to-Real Performance for High-Dynamic Skills – Real vs. Simulated Differences?
